title: Love Hostel
desc: Amidst bloodshed, deception, and desperate escapes, Jyothi and Ashu elope, prompting her family to hire a ruthless mercenary to hunt them down and end their love.

title: Coolie
desc: Zafar's obsession destroys Salma's family and shatters her mind. Years later, her sons Iqbal and Sunny unite to rescue her from his captivity and confront their dark past.

title: Jaat
desc: In a quiet coastal village ruled by fear, Varadaraja Ranatunga's tyranny goes unchecked-until a wandering stranger's clash with his men exposes the villagers' silent suffering.

title: Tezaab
desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

title: Naseeb
desc: Namdev, Raghu, Damu, and Jaggi win a lottery. Greed consumes Raghu and Damu, who murder Jaggi and frame Namdev. Returning later, Namdev seeks revenge against his betrayers.

title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers dream of wealth by investing in buildings. Kabir cons them, leaving them broke. Determined, they set out to avenge their humiliation and reclaim dignity.

title: Good Newwz
desc: Two couples with the same last name undergo IVF, eagerly awaiting their babies. Chaos erupts when they discover their sperm samples have been accidentally swapped.

title: Raanjhnaa
desc: Kundan has loved Zoya since childhood, but learns she loves another. When he discovers she lied about her fiance's religion, his heartbreak turns into uncontrollable rage and obsession.

title: Darlings
desc: Hamza and Badru's love marriage spirals into abuse and alcoholism. When his cruelty sparks a tragedy, Badru transforms her pain into power and sets out for revenge.

title: Anokha Bandhan
desc: A woman is asked to care for her brother-in-law when his mother passes away.

title: Taal
desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

title: Laila Majnu
desc: Qais and Laila fall in love in Kashmir but face family opposition. Fate separates them-Laila marries another man while Qais moves to London, heartbroken.

title: Karan Arjun
desc: Durga's sons, Karan and Arjun, set out to avenge their father's death but are killed by their cruel uncle. Years later, they are reincarnated to deliver justice.

title: No Entry
desc: Kishan, a loyal husband, disapproves of his friend Prem's infidelity. But when introduced to Bobby, a prostitute, Kishan's morals are tested, leading to complications, secrets, and unexpected choices.

title: Vedaa
desc: Vedaa, facing caste discrimination, trains as a boxer under Abhimanyu to seek justice for her siblings' murder, fighting both societal bias and the killers with courage and determination.

title: Crew
desc: Three cabin crew friends find themselves in a tough spot when an unknown schemer throws a wrench in their plans. Can they uncover the truth and save the day?
